scope: W2a/W2b plus BATCH2 B1/B2/B3 bounded expansion; no dependency edits; B3 pending independent SPEC then NEW SECURITY

patches.change: New local LiteLLM-only metadata helper, not upstream vendor code: borrow original scoped DNS-pinned client for one GET on five fixed existing routes; 256KiB identity response/5s total, depth8/list100/object128/node10000 bounds. Explicit single model/group selectors and bounded user pagination; validate typed required envelopes/identity then reuse positive output_policy.record. No keys/provider params/api_base/config/email/teams/membership/spend, retries, new grants or shared transport edits. See docs/litellm-metadata-delivery.md; candidate pending independent review, not HA/backend acceptance.

LiteLLM metadata batch adds five strict bounded read schemas and existing requires_backend opt-in. Explicit single selectors; user page1..10000/page_size1..100, four roles, up to20 IDs, team; no email/custom sort. JSON Schema character exclusions match strict runtime validation for final line terminators. Existing products, schemas, operations, grants and readonly defaults unchanged.

Explicit B3 scope exception: default-OFF Tool requires_backend and selector-bound backend_required_operations, validate opt-in operation metadata. authorize validates/normalizes before backend precondition and before mutating caller arguments, using existing configured property or legacy URL+key. Both existing gateway authorization passes inherit it. No gateway-name guard, persisted schema/migration/lifecycle or general grants change; local unconfigured startup/list semantics retained. SPEC then different NEW SECURITY required. 0.1.6 (0.1.5 RC review F3, R1): filter_list rebuilds tools/list: the tools and a string nextCursor only, the first entry per name; each tool has the gateway's name and pinned inputSchema, the child's title/description/annotations.title as strings, and the four hint booleans when cautious or when the local tool has no write path; outputSchema, execution, icons, _meta and unknown members are dropped.

B3 strict tags-only catalog, list-only executions with includeData=false, status-only health, existing folders get-only addition. Portable cursor/segment schemas, omitted-not-null optional filters, exact backend preconditions only for three new names and folder get. Old folder operations/grants unchanged.
Register B3 schemas without changing ChildSpec, production port, minimal environment, startup or old tools.

New local narrow adapters preserve actual pinned handlers/client methods. Single-page tags (250 scan then original filter), executions includeData=false (<=100), explicit folder get; positive bounded metadata. Health actual healthz/workflows fallback only, suppress version/settings/npm/official-MCP auxiliaries before DNS/connect, service availability not key-permission proof. New requests capped 64KiB decompressed/5s per HTTP/zero redirects and retries; original auth/pinning retained, old retry/settings fallback untouched. Invocation-local public fixed failure classification; no raw-error retention or diagnostic projection. Private new-action validation before dispatch; no dependency edits or new transport origin.

B2 three default-readonly bounded Odoo tools: fixed partner catalog, live self-relation metadata depth1, missing-required name/active counts only. No new grants or record fields. Strict schemas reject unknown/extra/cross-instance and broad upstream defaults.

B2 genuine pinned handlers run with invocation-local context/client facade, not replaced algorithms. Fixed ir.model search_read model/limit/fields, explicit partner fields_get names/attributes and positive metadata projection BEFORE handler/cache; quality permits at most two required stored name/active search_count calls, no samples/group/private fields/related records. Two projected catalog cache keys per client identity/lifespan, immutable ChildSpec credential generation, source guard even on hits, explicit refresh with no freshness promise. Generic failure for outer/nested/backend/malformed errors; Exception only, execution-owned single worker unchanged. Catalog SDK adds empty name default, quality SDK adds null optional fields; neither contains backend labels/instance. No dependency/source wheel edits. 0.1.2: a native failure report whose error is exactly one fixed transport code (PUBLIC_FAILURES, or BACKEND_HTTP_ERROR status=NNN) is returned as that code, e.g. BACKEND_RPC_FAULT for an account without ir.model read access; any other failure text stays BACKEND_RESPONSE_INVALID, and a failed schema_catalog clears its cache.

B1 ten source-backed tools: strict nested pure preview/partner count/internal-note/safe graph schemas; exact default-off writer grants, no arbitrary executor or activation. P2 schema repair closes unmatched connection keys alongside patternProperties for create and nested workflow validation. Portable GraphName schema metadata additionally forbids disallowed characters anywhere, including trailing line terminators, across node ids/names, edge targets and connection keys; strict runtime regex and reserved-name validators unchanged.
B1 positive bounded partner count and static template metadata projection; drop ORM domains/context/private fields, resources/read never authorized.

B3 adds pre-load catalog/official-MCP/npm helper guards and installs metadata_reads.cjs. Existing fixed-origin DNS/TLS/redirect policy and B1 create catch/metadata validation retained. Adjacent read-error P1: final public formatter uses only guarded N8nApiError type/status/known code; AsyncLocalStorage retains fixed classification per invocation, never raw errors. Wrap the seven genuine enabled API handler branches (workflow list/minimal/delete/create, folder list/create/rename), project failures to success=false/error/code, and normalize ordinary rejections without reading returned diagnostics. Successful business output is unchanged, not universal DLP. Strict API/error/handler/server-dispatch digests checked before runtime loading. Raw handleN8nApiError, settings fallback and preconnection retries remain internal and unchanged. Folder personal-project resolution keeps its native projects-to-workflows fallback. Errors/cancellation do not imply rollback, no commit or exactly-once; write errors explicitly warn outcome may be unknown. No new tools, grants, clients or endpoints; independent SPEC then NEW SECURITY review required.

B2 registers three narrow Odoo read schemas. W2b v3 per-tool/operation grants, typed module mode, exact native disabled-tool universe and grant-controlled readonly. Reserve only the fixed read-only EMQX cluster-status / LiteLLM model-list probe in private loopback registration independently of public disables; parent authorization/list filtering remains authoritative, with real backend reads and unchanged readiness validation. Disable FastMCP banner/update checks to prevent unauthenticated PyPI lookup and version-cache pollution of the guarded clean restart directory; never delete or permit unknown CWD contents. 0.1.3: health_probe()/health_probe_success(): Odoo's HealthMonitor probe is the child's private woow_backend_probe (not in TOOLS, never listed or authorized publicly), accepted only as exactly {'uid': positive int}; PROBES and every other product's probe unchanged. 0.1.4: OpenDesign's probe also accepts {"ok": true, "version": non-empty string} (OpenDesign 0.21.1 on the test HA; the status ok/healthy shape is kept); child_spec reserves the native probe name from health_probe(), the probe HealthMonitor actually calls. 0.1.4: Odoo Manage's HealthMonitor probe is its private woow_backend_probe too (same {'uid': positive int} rule). RC review: a present OpenDesign status or ok must agree, and the version must be a plain token ([0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z.+_-]{0,63}).
W2b bounded positive output projection: at most 100 rows, 256 characters per scalar string, no nested/unknown fields; wrong envelope rejects. Not a sanitizer for arbitrary agent/file output.

Before stock CLI starts, replace RedirectTransport with configured-origin XMLRPC transport. Deny all redirects, pin validated DNS, retain verified hostname/SNI, sanitize faults; bound SDK sync dispatch to one worker. B1 source-guard pure builder/diagnostic and aggregate handlers; project actual aggregate results to bounded partner counts. B2 installs isolated source-guarded narrow client/context facade before existing one-worker dispatch, preserving genuine metadata/quality handlers and all previous handlers. 0.1.3: registers the private health probe woow_backend_probe (not in TOOLS, never listed or authorized by the gateway): it authenticates a fresh client via the guarded odoo_client.get_odoo_client on its own one-thread OwnedWorkers, never the users' single tool worker, and returns only the uid; startup fails if that tool name was already taken.

Before stock CLI starts, replace both pooled XMLRPC transport classes with configured-origin DNS-pinned transport; keep database header and verified TLS, sanitize faults. W2b source-guarded module authentication/ACL REST helpers now use scoped sync HTTPX transport instead of urllib; fixed API-key-only paths and strict consumed auth/permission types. No full YOLO or backend module installation. B1 source-guard actual tools; positive aggregate/template output projections, internal-note writer still requires existing module write ACL. P1 fixed-message boundary surrounds the real post handler; typed bounded cause classification, no exception text inspection, BaseException cancellation preserved. Validate real res.partner.message_post return before native list/int coercion (one genuine non-bool positive int32 ID only), then project success/message_id. No fake success, RPC retry, rollback or no-effect-after-error claim. 0.1.4: registers the private health probe woow_backend_probe on OdooMCPServer construction (server.py source-guarded): a fresh OdooConnection with its own PerformanceManager connects and authenticates on its own one-thread OwnedWorkers, never the shared session connection, returns only the uid and disconnects; startup fails if the name is taken.

Run actual SDK handlers with four-worker bounded sync dispatch; initialize shared HTTP client before threads and close at launcher shutdown; no schema/permission changes. 0.1.2: GET /api/agents (OpenDesign probes every agent CLI, about 8 s on a small HA host) may wait up to 20 s between reads (within the gateway's 120 s stream lifetime); connect, write and pool keep 5 s; every other request keeps the upstream 5 s client; the server starts only under __main__.

Local scoped HTTPX/httpcore and XMLRPC transports. Validate all DNS answers before numeric-address fallback under one DNS/TCP deadline; retain original Host/SNI/TLS. Process-wide four-worker DNS executor with immediate four-slot admission and execution-owned capacity through caller timeout/cancellation, shared by sync/async/XMLRPC and all Hermes clients. Supervisor owns hard process-group shutdown. Embedded _SOURCE_HASHES fail closed on seven locked HTTPX/httpcore implementation files before private pool adaptation. Lazy sync/async response wrappers normalize iteration and close failures, including unmapped httpcore cleanup errors, without buffering or taking over HTTPX/core close ownership. Non-2xx cleanup retains status precedence; cancellation is not caught. Shared type-based public error mapping and explicit enabled-handler decorators cover decoding/JSON failures after transport iteration; successful business values and signatures are unchanged. No global socket/resolver/SSRF modification.

Adapt SDK registered sync function dispatch, preserving validation/output metadata; reject overload, retain capacity through cancellation; child process-group supervisor owns hard shutdown deadline. 0.1.3: admission and execution ownership factored into OwnedWorkers (same semantics), which BoundedTools extends and the Odoo (0.1.3) and Odoo Manage (0.1.4) health probes use for their own thread. 0.1.5: the SDK source guard runs wherever BoundedTools does (Odoo and OpenDesign), so both venvs are listed; OwnedWorkers alone (Odoo Manage) does not run it.
